offerings.name: Reader for web search and SERP
offerings.pricing: Token-based: Prototype Development 1 Billion tokens for $50 ($0.050 / 1M tokens); Production Deployment 11 Billion tokens for $500 ($0.045 / 1M tokens). Search requests cost a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10000 tokens.
offerings.price_basis: 按 token 计费；单次搜索从 10000 tokens 起，无法精确换算每千次请求
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens; Toy Experiment: 10 Million tokens, non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC), Free.
offerings.output_type: 返回前五个搜索结果及其 URL 和网页内容，转换为干净、适合 LLM 的文本；JSON 模式返回五项结构化列表
offerings.note: 端点 https://s.jina.ai；免费/付费密钥 100 RPM，Premium 1000 RPM；平均延迟 2.5s。
